en: The postcard features a serene lakeside scene with three men in uniforms rowing a boat across a tranquil pond, bordered in the foreground by a wooden fence and overhung by willow branches. In the background, there is a large historic building partially hidden behind trees, and a church spire prominent against the sky. The caption reads 'Zwickau. Partie am Schwanenteich.' in red letters in the top right corner.
